E21a_minus_E10a.interpretation_guard: A positive AP_small/score delta with near-zero oracle-IoU delta supports a score/ranking mechanism but is not causal proof.

E16a_minus_E10a.interpretation_guard: If localization-oriented E16a improves oracle geometry without AP_small, this weighs against pure localization as the sole bottleneck.

next_step.rationale: No single family is sufficiently dominant across the two diagnostic IoU points. Do not train a new module from this result.

hard_boundaries: Do not change the formal max_det=500 protocol based on this diagnostic.
Do not interpret post-NMS coverage failure as pure backbone feature failure; NMS/assignment can also contribute.
Do not train E22a unless decision.choice explicitly selects E22A_SCALE_ISOLATED_P2_CLASSIFICATION_GUIDANCE.
Do not resume from E21a best.pt for a future E22a; preserve the deterministic E10a parent protocol.
The 10 pp dominance margin is a resource/decision rule, not a statistical significance threshold.
